function.name: EXPLOSION
function.param: Number of clouds of particles that will be created.
Maximum size that the cloud gets. In pixels.
Number of Frames that explosion will generate. (1-20)
Number of times that the graph will be stumped (1-5).
Density of the particles in a cloud.
Width of map that will be generated.
Height of map that will be generated.
function.abstract: It generates an explosion with the indicated parameters

description.p: It creates an explosion to reproduce it by .

This function returns a map of 8 bits where the explosion will be generated. It can be used this function in 8 or 16 bits, but the returned map always will be of 8 and will use the palette that we have saved in memory. In case of that an explosion is on process or it can not be created a new explosion, it will return -1.
